test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 12 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who among the following is the supreme commander of the Indian armed forces?
solution:
The correct answer is __President__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• President__ 

 __
 
• Article 52: There shall be a President of India.
 
• He is the constitutional head of the executive of India.
 
• The term of the office of the President is 5 years.
 
• He is the first citizen of India.
 
• He is an integral part of the Indian Parliament.
 
• He can submit his resignation to the Vice President of India.
 
• He is the supreme commander of the Indian Armed Forces
 
• First President of India: Dr. Rajendra Prasad
 
• **Current President: Droupadi Murmu (15th) **
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Prime Minister

 
 
• Article 75: There shall be the Prime Minister appointed by the President.
 
• Article 74: There shall be the Council of Ministers headed by the Prime Minister and give advice to the President.
 
• The Prime Minister holds the office as long as he/she enjoys the support of the majority in Lok Sabha.
 
• The Prime Minister can be a member of any of the houses of the Parliament.
 
• The Prime Minister submits his resignation to the President.
 
 
 
• Vice President​
 
 
• Article 63: There shall be the vice-president of India.
 
• He/She is the ex-officio chairman of Rajya Sabha.
 
• The term of the office of Vice-President is 5 years.
 
• If any vacancy occurs in the office of the President, he/she will act as the president of India.
 
• He is not a member of any house of the Parliament.
 
• First Vice-President: Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan
 
• **Current Vice-President: C. P. Radhakrishnan**
 
 
 
• Chief of Defense Staff
 
 
• The Chief of Defense Staff of the Indian Armed Forces(CDS) is the head of the military staff of the Indian Armed Forces.
 
• The Chief of Defense Staff has the authority to create theatre commands as and when needed.
 
• The task of the Chief of Defense Staff is to better standardize weapons procurement procedures and combining operations of the Army, Air Force, and Navy.
 
• First Chief Defense Staff: General Bipin Rawat
